title: Sources: after a deadly school strike in Iran, US Central Command changed its targeting process, integrated open-source data, and upgraded Palantir's Maven (Katrina Manson/Bloomberg)
summary: Katrina Manson / Bloomberg: Sources: after a deadly school strike in Iran, US Central Command changed its targeting process, integrated open-source data, and upgraded Palantir's Maven — The changes include refining processes for vetting targets and adding open-source data feeds to better track civilian movement.
